caption:
✨Whiteheads: What’s Really Happening Beneath Your Skin? 🔬💧

Noticing tiny white bumps on your face? 🤍 Those could be whiteheads, one of the most common types of acne!

But what causes them, and how can you prevent them? Let's break it down! 👇
